sections.Profile:
The "Evel Knievel" pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1977, is a classic solid-state machine themed around the famous stunt performer. Designed by Gary Gayton with artwork by Paul Faris, this machine is notable for being one of the first solid-state pinball machines and was produced in both solid-state and electro-mechanical versions.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1977–1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
